feature_source: Frozen learned selector recomputed on two-frame RGB observations recovered by replaying the original saved actions; state sequences match exactly, selector coordinates can differ by up to 0.5 native pixel
original_query_tracks: Saved during the K4 replay; no forecast recomputation
policy_upsampling: Exact saved 256 target pixel indices and per-parent counts, verified against the saved parent hash; targets retain their own XYZ and copy saved parent displacements

high_resolution_rendering.source: Native MuJoCo render of exact recorded query/success/baseline terminal states; original saved point coordinates and trajectories projected into the same external camera

feature_visualization.name: Motion-group-balanced foreground PCA
feature_visualization.fit_region: Recorded material-point peak motion >= 5 mm, visible at query, assigned to one of the four learned groups
feature_visualization.group_weighting: Equal total weight to each of four groups in each of four examples
feature_visualization.display: Rotate inside the first-three-PC subspace for query-group RGB separation; 3rd/97th weighted foreground percentiles; foreground saturation and value boost; background desaturation
